questions.question_english:
Consider the following combinations of tax sections and their subject matter under Chapter VI-A of the Income Tax Act, 1961:
I. Section 80C: Life Insurance Premium, PPF, and EPF contributions
II. Section 80D: Medical Insurance Premium and preventive health check-up expenses
III. Section 80U: Deduction in case of a resident person with disability
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english:
All three pairs are correctly matched under Chapter VI-A of the Income Tax Act, 1961:
- Section 80C provides tax deductions up to ₹1.5 lakh for specified savings and investments, including Life Insurance Premiums, Public Provident Fund (PPF), Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), and tuition fees.
- Section 80D provides deductions for payments made towards health insurance premiums (Mediclaim) for self, spouse, children, and parents, as well as preventive health check-ups up to ₹5,000.
- Section 80U provides a flat deduction for resident individual assessees certified as persons with disability (₹75,000 for standard disability of 40% or more, and ₹1,25,000 for severe disability of 80% or more).
Therefore, all statements I, II, and III are correct.
questions.explanation_hindi:
आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 के अध्याय VI-A के अंतर्गत तीनों युग्म सही सुमेलित हैं:
- युग्म I सही है: धारा 80C के तहत जीवन बीमा प्रीमियम, लोक भविष्य निधि (PPF), कर्मचारी भविष्य निधि (EPF), बच्चों की ट्यूशन फीस आदि में ₹1.5 लाख तक के निवेश पर कटौती मिलती है।
- युग्म II सही है: धारा 80D स्वयं, परिवार और माता-पिता के स्वास्थ्य बीमा प्रीमियम तथा ₹5,000 तक की प्रिवेंटिव हेल्थ चेकअप लागत पर कटौती की अनुमति देती है।
- युग्म III सही है: धारा 80U किसी प्रमाणित दिव्यांगता से पीड़ित निवासी व्यक्ति को एकमुश्त कर कटौती (सामान्य दिव्यांगता पर ₹75,000 तथा गंभीर दिव्यांगता पर ₹1,25,000) प्रदान करती है।
अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, and III

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 80C allows deductions for life insurance premiums, PPF, and EPF contributions. Section 80D governs deductions for health insurance payments. Section 80U provides tax relief for resident individuals who suffer from certified physical or mental disabilities. All three matching pairs accurately reflect statutory tax provisions under Chapter VI-A.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is the highest statutory authority in India for the administration, enforcement, and policy formulation of direct taxes, including the Income Tax?
options_english: The Goods and Services Tax Council (GST Council)
The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)
The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)
questions.explanation_english: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) is the apex statutory authority responsible for the administration and policy formulation of direct taxes (such as Income Tax and Corporation Tax) in India. It functions under the Central Boards of Revenue Act, 1963 and forms part of the Department of Revenue within the Ministry of Finance, Government of India. In contrast, the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) oversees indirect taxes (GST, Customs, Central Excise), the GST Council is a constitutional body under Article 279A, and the CAG is the supreme audit institution under Article 148.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय प्रत्यक्ष कर बोर्ड (CBDT) केंद्रीय राजस्व बोर्ड अधिनियम, 1963 के तहत कार्य करने वाला भारत में प्रत्यक्ष करों (आयकर और निगम कर) के प्रशासन, विधिक प्रवर्तन और नीति-निर्माण के लिए सर्वोच्च वैधानिक प्राधिकरण है। यह वित्त मंत्रालय के राजस्व विभाग का एक प्रमुख अंग है। इसके विपरीत, CBIC अप्रत्यक्ष करों (GST, कस्टम्स) का प्रशासन करता है, GST परिषद अनुच्छेद 279A के तहत एक संवैधानिक निकाय है, तथा CAG अनुच्छेद 148 के तहत सर्वोच्च लेखापरीक्षा प्राधिकारी है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Central Board of Direct Taxes, operating under the Central Boards of Revenue Act 1963 as part of the Department of Revenue within the Ministry of Finance, is the highest statutory authority responsible for administering, enforcing, and formulating policy regarding direct taxes, including income tax, throughout India.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): The employer's contribution to the National Pension System (NPS) on behalf of a government employee up to 14% of the salary is allowed as a deduction to the employee under Section 80CCD(2).
Reason (R): Under the Old Tax Regime, this deduction under Section 80CCD(2) is available over and above the overall ceiling of ₹1.5 lakh prescribed under Section 80CCE.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is true: Under Section 80CCD(2) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any contribution made by the Central or State Government employer to the NPS account of an employee is eligible for deduction up to 14% of salary (Basic Pay + Dearness Allowance).
Reason (R) is true: Section 80CCE places an aggregate cap of ₹1,50,000 on deductions allowable under Sections 80C, 80CCC, and 80CCD(1). However, the deduction under Section 80CCD(2) is explicitly kept outside this ₹1.5 lakh ceiling, allowing the employee to claim the full benefit of employer NPS contributions over and above other Chapter VI-A investments. (Moreover, this deduction continues to be available even under the New Tax Regime under Section 115BAC). Because this statutory exclusion provides the structural framework enabling the deduction without impinging on the general ₹1.5 lakh limit, both statements are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) सही है: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 80CCD(2) के तहत केंद्र या राज्य सरकार द्वारा अपने कर्मचारी के NPS खाते में वेतन (मूल वेतन + DA) के 14% तक का अंशदान कर्मचारी की आय से कर कटौती के रूप में अनुमन्य है।

questions.question_hindi: एक सरकारी विद्यालय का शिक्षक अपने टीयर-II राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली (NPS) खाते में ₹50,000 जमा करता है। क्या इस अंशदान पर आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 80C के तहत कर कटौती का दावा किया जा सकता है?

हाँ, बशर्ते शिक्षक ने उसी वर्ष PPF निवेश कटौती का दावा न किया हो।

हाँ, परंतु इसका दावा केवल धारा 80CCD(1B) के तहत ₹50,000 तक ही किया जा सकता है।

questions.question_english: A government school teacher deposits ₹50,000 into their Tier-II National Pension System (NPS) account. Can this contribution be claimed as a tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961?
options_english: Yes, all Tier-II NPS contributions are unconditionally eligible under Section 80C.
Yes, provided the teacher does not simultaneously claim any PPF investment deduction.
No, Tier-II NPS contributions are not eligible under Section 80C for state government employees.
Yes, but it can only be claimed under Section 80CCD(1B) up to ₹50,000.
questions.explanation_english: Contributions made into a Tier-II NPS account represent voluntary, non-locked savings that can be withdrawn at any time, and generally do not qualify for any tax deductions. Under Section 80C(2)(xxv) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 (introduced via the NPS Tier-II Tax Saver Scheme, 2020), deduction under Section 80C is strictly restricted to Central Government employees who contribute to a designated Tier-II account with a mandatory 3-year lock-in period. State government employees and private subscribers are not eligible for this deduction. Furthermore, Section 80CCD(1B) provides an exclusive deduction of up to ₹50,000 only for contributions to Tier-I NPS accounts, not Tier-II accounts.
questions.explanation_hindi: NPS टीयर-II खाता एक स्वैच्छिक बचत खाता (withdrawal-friendly facility) है जिसमें जमा राशि पर सामान्यतः कोई कर छूट नहीं मिलती। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 80C(2)(xxv) के तहत 'NPS Tier-II Tax Saver Scheme 2020' के माध्यम से धारा 80C की कटौती केवल केंद्र सरकार के कर्मचारियों को 3 वर्ष की अनिवार्य लॉक-इन अवधि के साथ प्रदान की जाती है। राज्य सरकार के कर्मचारियों अथवा अन्य अंशदाताओं के लिए टीयर-II अंशदान धारा 80C के तहत पात्र नहीं है। इसके अतिरिक्त, धारा 80CCD(1B) के तहत ₹50,000 की विशेष कटौती केवल टीयर-I खाते के लिए अनुमन्य है, टीयर-II के लिए नहीं। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) No, Tier-II NPS contributions are not eligible under 80C for state employees.

Contributions made into a Tier-II National Pension System account are voluntary savings that do not qualify for tax deductions under Section 80C for state government employees. Only central government employees qualify for Section 80C deductions on Tier-II NPS contributions under specific conditions involving a mandatory three-year lock-in period.

options_hindi: फॉर्म 16 (Form 16)

questions.question_english: Which prescribed statutory document serves as the primary declaration of claims and proof of investments/expenses submitted by a salaried employee to their Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) for TDS estimation?
options_english: Form 16
Form 26AS
Form 10E
Form 12BB
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 26C of the Income Tax Rules, 1962, Form 12BB is the prescribed statutory statement of claims by an employee for deduction of tax under Section 192. Every salaried employee must submit Form 12BB to their employer/DDO along with documentary evidence to claim deductions for House Rent Allowance (HRA), Leave Travel Concession (LTC), interest on home loans (under Section 24(b)), and Chapter VI-A deductions (such as Sections 80C, 80D, 80CCD). In contrast, Form 16 is the TDS certificate issued by the DDO, Form 26AS is the annual tax credit statement generated from the TRACES portal, and Form 10E is filed for claiming tax relief on salary arrears under Section 89(1).
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर नियम, 1962 के नियम 26C के तहत 'फॉर्म 12BB' वेतनभोगी कर्मचारी द्वारा अपने नियोक्ता/DDO को प्रस्तुत किया जाने वाला अनिवार्य वैधानिक घोषणा-पत्र है। इसी फॉर्म में कर्मचारी मकान किराया भत्ता (HRA), अवकाश यात्रा रियायत (LTC), गृह ऋण पर ब्याज (धारा 24b) और अध्याय VI-A की कटौतियों (धारा 80C, 80D आदि) का विवरण और साक्ष्य संलग्न करता है ताकि DDO धारा 192 के तहत सटीक TDS काट सके। फॉर्म 16 नियोक्ता द्वारा जारी टीडीएस प्रमाण पत्र है, 26AS टैक्स क्रेडिट विवरण है, तथा फॉर्म 10E धारा 89(1) के तहत एरियर पर राहत हेतु भरा जाता है। अतः विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Form 12BB

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Form 12BB is the prescribed statutory declaration form under Rule 26C of Income Tax Rules. Salaried employees must submit Form 12BB to their employer to declare details and present documentary proof of tax-saving investments, house rent paid, home loan interest, and eligible allowances to claim tax deductions.

questions.question_hindi:
आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) के दायित्वों और कर्मचारी के अधिकारों के संबंध में निम्नलिखित घटनाक्रम पर विचार कीजिए:
I. एक कर्मचारी विद्यालय द्वारा निर्धारित समय सीमा के भीतर फॉर्म 12BB और निवेश साक्ष्य प्रस्तुत करने में विफल रहता है।
II. DDO किसी भी असत्यापित कटौती को शामिल किए बिना धारा 192 के तहत TDS की गणना करता है और उसी अनुसार कर की कटौती करता है।
III. कर्मचारी बाद में आयकर विभाग के समक्ष अपना व्यक्तिगत आयकर रिटर्न (ITR) दाखिल करते समय अपने वास्तविक निवेशों के आधार पर कटौती का दावा करता है तथा रिफंड मांगता है।
क्या उपर्युक्त प्रक्रिया आयकर नियमों के अंतर्गत विधिक रूप से मान्य और स्वीकार्य है?
options_hindi: नहीं, DDO कर्मचारी की संभावित कटौतियों पर विचार न करके अत्यधिक कर काटकर एक विधिक अपराध करता है।
नहीं, यदि नियोक्ता को दी गई घोषणा में कटौतियों का उल्लेख नहीं था, तो कर्मचारी को ITR में कटौती का दावा करने से कानूनन रोक दिया जाता है।
हाँ, DDO वैधानिक रूप से सुरक्षित है और कर्मचारी अपने व्यक्तिगत ITR में कटौती का दावा करके रिफंड प्राप्त कर सकता है।
हाँ, परंतु DDO को फॉर्म 16 के भाग B में असत्यापित निवेशों का भी उल्लेख करना अनिवार्य होता है।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following sequence of events regarding a Drawing and Disbursing Officer's (DDO) responsibilities and an employee's rights:
I. An employee fails or refuses to submit Form 12BB and investment proofs within the timeline set by the school.
II. The DDO calculates TDS under Section 192 without granting unverified deductions and deducts tax accordingly.
III. The employee later files their personal Income Tax Return (ITR) with the Income Tax Department and claims deductions based on actual eligible investments, seeking a refund.
Is the above sequence legally valid and acceptable under Income Tax rules?
options_english: No, the DDO commits an offense by deducting excess tax without considering eligible deductions.
No, employees are legally barred from claiming deductions in their ITR if omitted from employer declarations.
Yes, the DDO is legally protected and the employee can claim eligible deductions and refund in their personal ITR.
Yes, but the DDO must report the unverified investment claims in Part B of Form 16.
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 192 read with Rule 26C of the Income Tax Rules, 1962, a DDO is legally prohibited from allowing tax deductions without having received Form 12BB along with substantiated documentary proof. If an employee fails to submit proofs within the stipulated deadline, the DDO is legally bound to compute TDS on the basis of available records without allowing unverified deductions. This procedure protects the DDO from penalties for short deduction under Section 201. Simultaneously, the employee does not forfeit their statutory rights; under Section 139 and Section 237, the employee can claim all bona fide Chapter VI-A deductions while filing their personal ITR and receive a refund of excess TDS deducted directly from the Income Tax Department.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 192 और नियम 26C के तहत DDO केवल उन्हीं कटौतियों को स्वीकार कर सकता है जिनके लिए कर्मचारी ने फॉर्म 12BB और दस्तावेजी साक्ष्य प्रस्तुत किए हों। साक्ष्य न मिलने पर DDO बिना कटौती के TDS काटने के लिए विधिक रूप से बाध्य है और धारा 201 के तहत किसी भी शास्ति से सुरक्षित रहता है। वहीं दूसरी ओर, कर्मचारी के वैधानिक अधिकार समाप्त नहीं होते हैं; धारा 139 के तहत अपना व्यक्तिगत आयकर रिटर्न (ITR) भरते समय वह अपने सभी वैध निवेशों का दावा कर सकता है तथा धारा 237 के तहत अधिक कटे हुए कर का रिफंड सीधे आयकर विभाग से प्राप्त कर सकता है। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Yes, DDO is covered and employee can claim refund in ITR.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: refund in ITR. If an employee fails to submit Form 12BB and investment proofs, the DDO must calculate TDS without allowing unverified deductions. This action fully complies with tax rules. The employee retains the legal right to claim valid tax deductions and seek a tax refund directly when filing their personal Income Tax Return.

नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें से एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) कहा गया है:

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): A school collecting transportation fees for ferrying its enrolled students in school buses must charge and collect 18% GST on these fees.
Reason (R): Any service provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff, including transportation, is exempt from GST under current notifications.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is false: Under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) dated June 28, 2017 (Entry 66, Heading 9992), services provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff are completely exempt from GST. Specifically, transportation of students, faculty, and staff is an exempt educational service. A school cannot levy or collect 18% GST on transportation fees charged to its students.
Reason (R) is true: The GST statutory framework unconditionally exempts core educational and student-support services, including student transportation, catering, and security/cleaning services, provided by educational institutions (up to higher secondary school) to their enrolled students.
Thus, Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) गलत है: केंद्रीय कर (दर) अधिसूचना संख्या 12/2017 (प्रविष्टि 66) के अनुसार, किसी शैक्षणिक संस्थान द्वारा अपने छात्रों, संकाय और कर्मचारियों को प्रदान की जाने वाली सेवाएं वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) से पूर्णतः मुक्त हैं। विद्यालय द्वारा छात्रों से लिए जाने वाले बस परिवहन शुल्क पर 18% GST नहीं लगाया जा सकता।
कारण (R) सही है: GST नियमों के तहत किसी शैक्षणिक संस्थान (विशेषकर उच्चतर माध्यमिक स्तर तक) द्वारा अपने विद्यार्थियों को दी जाने वाली सेवाएं—जैसे परिवहन, भोजन/कैटरिंग, सुरक्षा एवं स्वच्छता सेवाएं—कर-मुक्त सेवाओं की श्रेणी में आती हैं।
अतः अभिकथन (A) गलत है, लेकिन कारण (R) सही है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Educational institutions providing services to their enrolled students are exempt from GST under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate). Transportation services supplied by a school to its students form an integral part of exempt educational services, meaning the school cannot collect eighteen percent GST on student transportation fees.

questions.question_english: If an educational institution conducts a vocational training course approved by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) or State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT), what is its status under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) law?
options_english: Exempt supply of services.
It is taxable at the rate of 12%.
It is taxable at the rate of 18%.
It is exempt only if offered entirely for free without registration fees.
questions.explanation_english: Under Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) (Entry 66), an 'educational institution' includes an institution providing services by way of an approved vocational education course. An 'approved vocational education course' is defined to include courses run by an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) or Industrial Training Centre affiliated to the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) or State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT). Services provided by such educational institutions to their students by way of education or training are exempt supplies under GST, regardless of whether registration or tuition fees are collected.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय कर (दर) अधिसूचना संख्या 12/2017 (प्रविष्टि 66) के तहत 'शैक्षणिक संस्थान' की परिभाषा में राष्ट्रीय व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण परिषद (NCVT) या राज्य व्यावसायिक प्रशिक्षण परिषद (SCVT) से संबद्ध ITI/संस्थानों द्वारा संचालित अनुमोदित व्यावसायिक शिक्षा पाठ्यक्रम शामिल हैं। ऐसे अनुमोदित पाठ्यक्रमों के माध्यम से विद्यार्थियों को प्रदान की जाने वाली शिक्षा और प्रशिक्षण सेवाएं GST से पूर्णतः मुक्त (Exempt supply) हैं, चाहे इसके लिए सामान्य शिक्षण या पंजीकरण शुल्क लिया गया हो। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Exempt supply of services.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under GST exemption notifications, services provided by an educational institution relating to approved vocational training courses qualify as exempt supplies. Vocational education courses conducted in accordance with curricula approved by the National Council for Vocational Training lead to recognized qualifications and are completely exempt from GST.

questions.question_hindi: एक सरकारी विद्यालय ग्रीष्मावकाश के दौरान एक व्यावसायिक प्रदर्शनी आयोजित करने के लिए अपने खेल के मैदान का एक हिस्सा एक निजी इवेंट मैनेजमेंट कंपनी को किराये पर देता है और किराये के रूप में ₹1,00,000 प्राप्त करता है। वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (GST) कानून के तहत यह लेन-देन किस प्रकार वर्गीकृत होगा?
options_hindi: GST के अध्यधीन सेवाओं की कर-योग्य आपूर्ति (टैक्सेबल सप्लाई)
कर-मुक्त क्योंकि यह राजस्व सरकारी खजाने में जमा होता है
कर-मुक्त क्योंकि खेल का मैदान शैक्षणिक अवसंरचना का हिस्सा है
भूमि की बिक्री के रूप में वर्गीकृत, जो GST के दायरे से पूर्णतः बाहर है

questions.question_english: A government school leases a portion of its playground to a private event management company during the summer vacations for hosting a commercial exhibition, receiving ₹1,00,000 as rent. Under GST law, how is this transaction classified?
options_english: Taxable supply of service subject to GST.
Exempt because the revenue goes to the government treasury.
Exempt because playgrounds are educational infrastructure.
Classified strictly as a sale of land, falling outside the purview of GST.
questions.explanation_english: Entry 66 of Notification No. 12/2017-Central Tax (Rate) exempts educational services provided by an educational institution to its students, faculty, and staff. When a school leases its premises, playground, or auditorium to a third-party commercial entity for hosting non-educational exhibitions or events, the transaction is treated as 'Renting of Immovable Property Service' under Section 7(1) read with Schedule II of the CGST Act, 2017. This constitutes a commercial supply of service and is fully taxable under GST (generally at 18%). Neither the school's public status nor the deposit of revenue into the treasury confers tax exemption on commercial renting.
questions.explanation_hindi: GST अधिसूचना संख्या 12/2017 के तहत छूट केवल छात्रों और कर्मचारियों को दी जाने वाली शैक्षणिक सेवाओं पर लागू होती है। जब कोई विद्यालय अपने परिसर या खेल के मैदान को किसी निजी कंपनी को व्यावसायिक प्रदर्शनी या गैर-शैक्षणिक आयोजन हेतु किराये पर देता है, तो इसे 'अचल संपत्ति का किराया' (Renting of Immovable Property) माना जाता है। CGST अधिनियम की धारा 7 एवं अनुसूची II के अनुसार यह सेवा की कर-योग्य आपूर्ति है जिस पर 18% की दर से GST देय होता है। सरकारी विद्यालय होना या राशि सरकारी खाते में जमा होना इसे कर-मुक्त नहीं बनाता। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Taxable supply of service subject to GST.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Leasing school grounds or infrastructure to commercial entities for hosting non-educational exhibitions or events is a commercial transaction. Because the transaction represents a business renting of immovable property rather than an exempt educational service, the rental revenue collected by the school is a fully taxable supply subject to GST.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following concepts under the Goods and Services Tax (GST) framework:
I. Input Tax Credit (ITC)
II. Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM)
III. Composition Scheme
IV. Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)
Which of these mechanisms requires a government department or public school to deduct 2% tax while making payment to a registered contractor for an invoice/contract exceeding ₹2.5 lakhs?
options_english: I
II
III
IV
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 51 of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017, government departments, local authorities, and specified governmental agencies are designated as deductors of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under GST. They are statutorily required to deduct tax at the rate of 2% (1% CGST + 1% SGST for intra-state supplies, or 2% IGST for inter-state supplies) from payments made to registered suppliers where the total value of taxable supply under a single contract exceeds ₹2,50,000 (excluding taxes). Hence, Mechanism IV (TDS) is the correct answer.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (CGST) अधिनियम, 2017 की धारा 51 के अनुसार, सरकारी विभागों, स्थानीय प्राधिकरणों और सरकारी संस्थाओं को पंजीकृत आपूर्तिकर्ताओं/ठेकेदारों को किए जाने वाले भुगतान से 2% (1% CGST + 1% SGST या 2% IGST) की दर से स्रोत पर कर कटौती (GST TDS) करनी होती है। यह अनिवार्यता तब लागू होती है जब किसी एकल अनुबंध के तहत कर-योग्य आपूर्ति का कुल मूल्य ₹2,50,000 (करों को छोड़कर) से अधिक हो। अतः तंत्र IV सही है और विकल्प D सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Section 51 of the CGST Act, government departments and public institutions acting as deductors are required to deduct Tax Deducted at Source under GST at two percent from payments made to registered contractors whenever individual supply contract values exceed two lakh fifty thousand rupees, excluding applicable taxes.

questions.question_english: Which electronically generated statutory document is mandatorily required under GST rules to accompany the movement and transit of goods exceeding ₹50,000 in consignment value?
options_english: E-way Bill
Bill of Lading
Consignment Note
GSTR-1
questions.explanation_english: Under Rule 138 of the CGST Rules, 2017, an Electronic Way Bill (E-way Bill) is a mandatory electronically generated document that must accompany any consignment of goods valued above ₹50,000 being moved from one place to another. The E-way Bill is generated on the common GST portal (ewaybillgst.gov.in) by the supplier, recipient, or transporter prior to dispatch. It contains details of the consignor, consignee, HSN code, invoice number, value, and vehicle details, ensuring tracking and indirect tax compliance during transit.
questions.explanation_hindi: CGST नियम, 2017 के नियम 138 के तहत ₹50,000 से अधिक मूल्य के माल के किसी भी परिवहन के लिए ई-वे बिल (E-way Bill) जनरेट करना अनिवार्य है। यह इलेक्ट्रॉनिक दस्तावेज माल के प्रेषण से पहले सामान्य पोर्टल (ewaybillgst.gov.in) पर जनरेट किया जाता है जिसमें आपूर्तिकर्ता, प्राप्तकर्ता, HSN कोड, इनवॉइस विवरण और वाहन संख्या दर्ज होती है। यह पारगमन के दौरान विधिक कर अनुपालन और निगरानी सुनिश्चित करता है। अतः विकल्प A सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) E-way Bill

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: An E-way Bill is an electronic document generated on the central GST portal that must accompany the transportation of goods valued above fifty thousand rupees. It ensures physical tracking of goods in transit and verifies that applicable indirect tax compliance has been fulfilled by the consignor or consignee.

अभिकथन (A): गवर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) के माध्यम से विद्यालयों द्वारा खरीदी जाने वाली वस्तुओं पर लागू GST दर GeM पोर्टल द्वारा प्रासंगिक HSN कोड के आधार पर स्वचालित रूप से निर्धारित की जाती है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही उत्तर का चयन कीजिए:

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements, one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): The applicable rate of GST on goods procured by schools via the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is automatically determined and populated by the GeM portal based on the relevant HSN code.
Reason (R): Government schools enjoy complete immunity from paying GST on physical goods purchased for institutional use, rendering the HSN code legally redundant.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is true, but (R) is false
(A) is false, but (R) is true
questions.explanation_english:
Assertion (A) is true: The Government e-Marketplace (GeM) platform automatically computes and applies the appropriate GST slabs based on the product's Harmonized System of Nomenclature (HSN) code and the respective supplier/buyer state jurisdictions.
Reason (R) is false: Government schools and public institutions are NOT exempt from paying GST when purchasing physical goods (such as furniture, sports goods, computers, laboratory apparatus, or stationery). While the educational services provided by schools to enrolled students are exempt from GST, schools acting as buyers must pay the applicable GST invoiced by registered vendors. Hence, HSN codes remain critically important for correct invoicing and tax computation.
Thus, Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
questions.explanation_hindi:
अभिकथन (A) सही है: गवर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पोर्टल उत्पादों के हार्मोनाइज्ड सिस्टम ऑफ नोमेनक्लेचर (HSN) कोड के आधार पर लागू GST दरों की स्वचालित रूप से गणना करता है और इनवॉइस में जोड़ता है।
कारण (R) गलत है: सरकारी विद्यालयों को भौतिक वस्तुओं (जैसे कंप्यूटर, फर्नीचर, लैब उपकरण आदि) की खरीद पर GST भुगतान से कोई सामान्य छूट प्राप्त नहीं है। यद्यपि विद्यालय द्वारा छात्रों को दी जाने वाली मुख्य शिक्षा सेवाएं GST-मुक्त हैं, परंतु एक खरीदार के रूप में विद्यालय को विक्रेता के इनवॉइस पर लागू GST का भुगतान करना अनिवार्य होता है। अतः HSN कोड कर निर्धारण के लिए अत्यंत प्रासंगिक है।
अतः (A) सही है, लेकिन (R) गलत है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Government e-Marketplace portal automatically computes applicable GST rates for goods based on Harmonized System of Nomenclature codes. Government schools are not exempt from paying GST on physical purchases like equipment; tax rates determined by HSN codes apply directly to school procurements through vendor invoicing.

questions.question_english: Which prescribed statutory return must be filed monthly by a government department or educational institution that is required to deduct TDS under Section 51 of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act?
options_english: GSTR-1
GSTR-7
GSTR-3B
GSTR-9
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 51 of the CGST Act, 2017 read with Rule 66 of the CGST Rules, 2017, every entity required to deduct tax at source (TDS deductors, including government departments and local authorities) must file a monthly return in Form GSTR-7 electronically on the common GST portal. Form GSTR-7 must be furnished on or before the 10th day of the month succeeding the calendar month in which the deduction was made. It reports details of TDS deducted, tax deposited, and supplier GSTINs, which auto-populates in the suppliers' electronic cash ledger. In contrast, GSTR-1 is for outward supplies, GSTR-3B is the monthly summary return, and GSTR-9 is the annual return.
questions.explanation_hindi: CGST अधिनियम, 2017 की धारा 51 और नियम 66 के तहत स्रोत पर कर कटौती (TDS) करने वाले सरकारी विभागों और संस्थानों को प्रत्येक माह 'फॉर्म GSTR-7' दाखिल करना अनिवार्य होता है। यह मासिक रिटर्न संबंधित माह के समाप्त होने के बाद आगामी माह की 10 तारीख तक GST पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन प्रस्तुत किया जाना चाहिए। इसमें काटे गए टीडीएस, अनुबंध राशि और आपूर्तिकर्ता के विवरण शामिल होते हैं, जिससे विक्रेता के इलेक्ट्रॉनिक कैश लेजर में टीडीएस क्रेडिट पहुंच जाता है। GSTR-1 जावक आपूर्ति, GSTR-3B मासिक सारांश और GSTR-9 वार्षिक रिटर्न है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) GSTR-7

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: GSTR-7 is the statutory monthly return required to be filed by entities mandated to deduct Tax Deducted at Source under Section 51 of the CGST Act. Government departments deducting GST TDS from supplier payments must submit GSTR-7 online to report details of tax withheld and remitted.

questions.question_english: A school Principal discovers that sports equipment worth ₹50,000 was purchased from an unregistered supplier who does not possess a PAN or GSTIN. Under the provisions of the CGST Act, 2017, what is the correct statutory position regarding GST compliance?
options_english: Unregistered purchases are strictly illegal; the items must be confiscated.
No GST is applicable on purchases from unregistered dealers under any statutory circumstances.
School pays GST under Reverse Charge Mechanism under Section 9(4).
The school must deduct 20% Income Tax TDS.
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 9(4) of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017, the Government may notify classes of registered persons and categories of goods or services where, upon procurement from an unregistered supplier, tax liability shifts to the recipient under the Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM). Under RCM, the recipient institution/department is legally obligated to self-invoice, calculate the applicable GST, and remit it directly into the government treasury. Purchases from unregistered dealers are not illegal per se, but shift compliance and tax remittance duties to the registered recipient entity.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय वस्तु एवं सेवा कर (CGST) अधिनियम, 2017 की धारा 9(4) के अनुसार, यदि कोई पंजीकृत व्यक्ति अथवा सरकारी संस्था किसी अपंजीकृत आपूर्तिकर्ता से विनिर्दिष्ट वस्तुओं या सेवाओं की खरीद करती है, तो रिवर्स चार्ज मैकेनिज्म (RCM) के तहत कर भुगतान का दायित्व सीधे प्राप्तकर्ता (विद्यालय/क्रेता) पर आ जाता है। RCM के तहत प्राप्तकर्ता संस्था को स्वयं चालान (self-invoice) बनाकर लागू GST सीधे सरकारी खजाने में जमा करना होता है। अपंजीकृत विक्रेता से खरीद अवैध नहीं होती, बल्कि कर भुगतान का विधिक दायित्व क्रेता पर स्थानांतरित हो जाता है। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) School pays GST under Reverse Charge Mechanism under Section 9(4).

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Mechanism under Section 9(4). When a registered tax entity or government department purchases specified goods or services from an unregistered supplier, tax liability shifts to the recipient under Section 9(4) of the CGST Act via the Reverse Charge Mechanism, requiring the recipient institution to pay the applicable GST directly to tax authorities.

questions.explanation_english: TRACES (TDS Reconciliation Analysis and Correction Enabling System), operated by the Income Tax Department, is the statutory centralized web portal that maps every tax deduction remitted by deductors (such as school DDOs) directly to the deductees' Permanent Account Numbers (PANs). Upon processing quarterly TDS statements filed in Form 24Q, TRACES reconciles payments via Challan Identification Numbers (CIN) or Book Identification Numbers (BIN), generates digitally signed Form 16 certificates, and populates the employee's Annual Tax Statement (Form 26AS) and AIS/TIS.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D (TRACES पोर्टल) है। आयकर विभाग द्वारा संचालित TRACES (टीडीएस समाधान विश्लेषण एवं सुधार सक्षम प्रणाली) वह वैधानिक केंद्रीकृत पोर्टल है जो DDO (कटौतीकर्ता) द्वारा जमा की गई प्रत्येक कर कटौती को सीधे संबंधित कर्मचारी के पैन (PAN) से मैप करता है। DDO द्वारा फॉर्म 24Q में त्रैमासिक टीडीएस विवरणी दाखिल करने के बाद, TRACES चालान पहचान संख्या (CIN) या बुक पहचान संख्या (BIN) के माध्यम से कर क्रेडिट का मिलान करता है, डिजिटल रूप से हस्ताक्षरित फॉर्म 16 जारी करता है और कर्मचारी के फॉर्म 26AS तथा AIS में कर क्रेडिट प्रदर्शित करता है।

उपर्युक्त चरणों का सही क्रमिक क्रम कौन-सा है?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following steps for computing Income Tax on Salary:
I. Compute Gross Salary.
II. Deduct Standard Deduction, Professional Tax, and Entertainment Allowance (if applicable) to get Net Salary.
III. Add Income from other heads and apply Chapter VI-A deductions to find Total Taxable Income.
IV. Apply tax slab rates and add Surcharge / Health and Education Cess.
What is the correct sequential order of the above steps?
options_english: I, III, II, IV
I, II, III, IV
II, I, III, IV
I, IV, II, III
questions.explanation_english: The computation of taxable income and tax liability on salary follows a strict statutory hierarchy under the Income Tax Act, 1961: (1) Compute Gross Salary under Section 17; (2) Deduct statutory deductions under Section 16 (Standard Deduction up to ₹50,000, Entertainment Allowance under Section 16(ii), and Professional Tax under Section 16(iii)) to arrive at 'Income under the Head Salaries'; (3) Aggregate with permissible income/losses from other heads (such as House Property or Other Sources) and subtract eligible deductions under Chapter VI-A (Sections 80C to 80U) to arrive at Total Taxable Income; (4) Apply the applicable slab rates under the chosen tax regime, deduct rebates under Section 87A, and finally add 4% Health and Education Cess plus any applicable surcharge.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर B (I, II, III, IV) है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 के तहत वेतन पर आयकर की गणना एक निर्धारित वैधानिक क्रम में होती है: सर्वप्रथम धारा 17 के तहत सकल वेतन की गणना की जाती है; दूसरे चरण में धारा 16 के तहत अनुमन्य कटौतियाँ (₹50,000 की मानक कटौती, व्यावसायिक कर आदि) घटाकर वेतन शीर्ष से शुद्ध आय ज्ञात की जाती है; तीसरे चरण में अन्य शीर्षों की आय जोड़कर तथा अध्याय VI-A (धारा 80C से 80U) की कटौतियाँ घटाकर कुल कर योग्य आय निकाली जाती है; और चौथे चरण में लागू कर स्लैब दरें लगाकर 4% स्वास्थ्य एवं शिक्षा उपकर तथा अधिभार जोड़कर अंतिम कर देयता निर्धारित की जाती है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, II, III, IV

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Computing income tax on salary follows a logical legal sequence: calculating gross salary first, subtracting standard deduction and professional tax to derive net salary second, aggregating income from other sources while deducting Chapter VI-A claims third, and applying tax slab rates with applicable cess fourth.

Assertion (A): The Health and Education Cess is calculated at the rate of 4% on the amount of income tax plus surcharge (if any).

questions.explanation_english: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, and R is the valid statutory rationale for A. questions.question_english: A government employee receives a Leave Travel Concession (LTC) advance of ₹80,000 but fails to produce travel tickets or undertake the journey within the stipulated period. What administrative and taxation action should the DDO take?
options_english: Permit the employee to refund the balance in the next financial year without interest or tax
Add the entire amount to the employee's salary and grant tax exemption under Section 10(5)
Recover the entire advance amount with penal interest and treat it as taxable salary if not adjusted
Write off the entire amount as administrative expenditure without verifying travel vouchers
questions.explanation_english: Under Central Civil Services (LTC) Rules read with the Income Tax Act, 1961, LTC tax exemption under Section 10(5) and Rule 2B is admissible strictly upon actual travel undertaken and supported by valid proof of expenditure (tickets/boarding passes). If an employee draws an LTC advance but fails to undertake the journey within the prescribed time limit or fails to submit final adjustment bills, the entire advance must be recovered in a single lump sum along with penal interest (typically 2% over GPF interest rate). In taxation terms, any unadjusted advance cannot claim Section 10(5) exemption and forms part of taxable salary for TDS calculation under Section 192.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर C है। सीसीएस (एलटीसी) नियमावली तथा आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 10(5) व नियम 2B के अंतर्गत एलटीसी पर कर छूट केवल वास्तविक यात्रा और वैध यात्रा प्रमाणक प्रस्तुत करने पर ही प्राप्त होती है। यदि कोई कर्मचारी अग्रिम लेकर निर्धारित अवधि में यात्रा नहीं करता या समायोजन बिल प्रस्तुत नहीं करता, तो आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) द्वारा अग्रिम की संपूर्ण राशि दंडात्मक ब्याज सहित एकमुश्त वसूल की जाती है। कर की दृष्टि से, असमायोजित अग्रिम पर धारा 10(5) की छूट नहीं मिलती और इसे टीडीएस गणना हेतु वेतन में जोड़कर कर योग्य माना जाता है।

questions.question_english: Which of the following defines the condition for relief under Section 89(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 on arrears of salary?
options_english: The employee must be a senior citizen and have no other income from any source
The arrears must be disbursed strictly on the first day of the financial year
The arrears amount must exceed 50% of the employee's basic pay in the current year
The tax payable in the current year on arrears must be higher than the tax that would have been paid had it been received in the respective earlier years
questions.explanation_english: Section 89(1) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 provides relief to salaried employees when salary arrears, advance salary, or family pension arrears are received in a lump sum in a single financial year, pushing the employee into a higher tax bracket. Relief under Section 89(1) (calculated in accordance with Rule 21A) is admissible only if the tax computed on the total income including arrears in the receipt year exceeds the aggregate tax that would have been payable had the arrears been taxed in the respective years to which they pertain. If there is no additional tax burden caused by the lump-sum receipt, relief under Section 89(1) equals zero.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 89(1) (नियम 21A के साथ पठित) के तहत वेतन के बकाए पर राहत तभी प्रदान की जाती है जब बकाए का एकमुश्त भुगतान प्राप्त होने के कारण चालू वित्तीय वर्ष में कर्मचारी पर पड़ने वाला कर भार उस कुल अतिरिक्त कर से अधिक हो, जो बकाया राशि को संबंधित पूर्ववर्ती वर्षों की आय में जोड़कर गणना करने पर बनता। यदि चालू वर्ष में कर दर में कोई वृद्धि नहीं होती है, तो धारा 89(1) के तहत कोई राहत देय नहीं होती।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) The tax in the current year with arrears is higher than the tax that would have been payable in the relevant past years

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Relief under Section 89(1) is available when an employee receives arrears or advance salary resulting in higher tax liability in the receipt year than what would have been incurred had the income been taxed in the respective past years. The mathematical difference between the two tax calculations forms the eligible relief under Rule 21A.

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): DDOs are legally empowered to grant relief under Section 89(1) while calculating TDS on arrears of salary.
Reason (R): The employee must furnish particulars of such arrears in Form 10E to the employer/tax portal to enable the DDO to allow the relief.
In the context of the above statements, which of the following is correct?
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, and Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A). Under Section 192(2A) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, a Drawing and Disbursing Officer is legally authorized to compute and allow relief under Section 89(1) while estimating TDS on salary arrears paid to government or semi-government employees. However, a mandatory statutory condition is that the employee must compute the relief under Rule 21A and electronically furnish the particulars in Form 10E on the e-filing portal of the Income Tax Department and submit the acknowledgment to the DDO. Without Form 10E, the DDO cannot legally grant the relief.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर A है। अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या है। आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 192(2A) के तहत सरकारी विद्यालयों के DDO को वेतन बकाए के भुगतान पर टीडीएस काटते समय धारा 89(1) के तहत राहत देने का कानूनी अधिकार प्राप्त है। परंतु इसके लिए अनिवार्य शर्त यह है कि संबंधित कर्मचारी नियम 21A के अनुसार राहत की गणना करके आयकर विभाग के ई-फाइलिंग पोर्टल पर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप से फॉर्म 10E दाखिल करे और उसकी प्रति DDO को सौंपे। फॉर्म 10E के बिना DDO धारा 89 की राहत अनुमन्य नहीं कर सकता।

questions.question_english: If an employee has income from house property comprising an annual loss of ₹1,50,000 (due to home loan interest), how should the DDO treat this loss when deducting TDS from salary under the Old Tax Regime?
options_english: Disallow the loss entirely since the DDO is restricted solely to considering salary income
Set off the entire loss of ₹1,50,000 against salary income upon submission of valid declaration and proof
Allow only ₹50,000 as set-off and direct the employee to carry forward the remaining balance
Demand written permission from the jurisdictional Income Tax Assessing Officer before allowing set-off
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 192(2B) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, a salaried employee is permitted to declare to their employer/DDO any other income or loss under the head 'Income from House Property'. Under Section 71(3A), loss under the head house property (primarily arising from housing loan interest deduction under Section 24(b)) is allowed to be set off against income under any other head (including salaries) up to a maximum limit of ₹2,00,000 in a financial year. Since the declared loss of ₹1,50,000 is within the statutory ₹2,00,000 cap, the DDO is legally mandated to set off the full ₹1,50,000 against the employee's salary income for TDS calculation upon receiving Form 12BB and the bank loan interest certificate.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर B है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192(2B) तथा धारा 71(3A) के अनुसार, एक कर्मचारी गृह संपत्ति से होने वाली हानि (गृह ऋण के ब्याज के कारण) को वेतन से टीडीएस गणना हेतु DDO के समक्ष घोषित कर सकता है। धारा 71(3A) के तहत किसी भी वित्तीय वर्ष में गृह संपत्ति की अधिकतम ₹2,00,000 तक की हानि को वेतन आय के विरुद्ध समायोजित (Set-off) किया जा सकता है। चूँकि यहाँ घोषित हानि ₹1,50,000 है जो कि ₹2 लाख की विधिक सीमा के भीतर है, अतः बैंक ब्याज प्रमाण पत्र प्राप्त होने पर DDO वेतन आय के विरुद्ध इस संपूर्ण राशि के समायोजन की अनुमति देगा।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Set off the entire loss of ₹1,50,000 against salary income upon verification of loan certificate

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Section 192(2B) read with Section 71(3A), an employee can declare house property losses (housing loan interest under Section 24(b)) to the DDO. The law permits setting off house property loss against salary income up to a statutory ceiling of ?2,00,000 per financial year. Since ?1,50,000 is within this cap, the DDO must adjust it upon receiving proper proof.

questions.question_english: A teacher informs the DDO that they have an additional income of ₹50,000 from Bank Fixed Deposits and requests that tax on it be deducted at source from their salary. What should the DDO do under the Income Tax Act?
options_english: Reject the request as bank interest TDS must be deducted exclusively by the concerned commercial bank
Direct the employee to obtain a formal No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Income Tax Department
Advise the employee to deposit Advance Tax independently instead of adjusting through salary TDS
Include this ₹50,000 under 'Income from Other Sources' in the tax computation and deduct TDS accordingly
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 192(2B) of the Income Tax Act, 1961, a salaried employee is statutorily entitled to declare to the DDO any income chargeable under any other head of income (such as 'Income from Other Sources', including bank interest or dividend income). Upon receiving such a written declaration from the employee, the DDO is legally required to take this additional income into account while computing total taxable income and deduct the appropriate higher TDS from the monthly salary. However, the DDO cannot take into account any loss under other heads except under the head 'Income from House Property'.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 192(2B) के प्रावधानों के तहत, एक वेतनभोगी कर्मचारी को यह अधिकार प्राप्त है कि वह अन्य शीर्षों (जैसे बैंक ब्याज, लाभांश आदि) से होने वाली किसी भी आय का विवरण अपने DDO को दे सकता है। ऐसी घोषणा प्राप्त होने पर, DDO उस ₹50,000 को कर्मचारी की कुल कर योग्य आय में 'अन्य स्रोतों से आय' के रूप में जोड़ेगा और वित्तीय वर्ष के शेष महीनों के वेतन से तदनुसार टीडीएस की उच्चतर राशि काटेगा।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Include this ₹50,000 under Income from Other Sources and adjust the monthly salary TDS accordingly

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Section 192(2B) enables an employee to declare income from other heads, including interest from bank deposits under Income from Other Sources, to the DDO. Upon receipt of such declaration, the DDO is legally obliged to include that income in the employee's total computation and deduct higher salary TDS, preventing advance tax interest penalties for the employee.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following limits under Chapter VI-A deductions (Old Regime):
I. The aggregate deduction under Section 80C, 80CCC, and 80CCD(1) is capped at ₹1,50,000 under Section 80CCE.
II. Deduction under Section 80CCD(2) for employer's contribution to NPS is over and above the ₹1.5 lakh limit of Section 80CCE.
III. Section 80D allows a deduction up to ₹25,000 for health insurance of self, spouse, and dependent children, plus an additional ₹50,000 for senior citizen parents.
Which of the above statements are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: All three statements I, II, and III are completely accurate under Chapter VI-A of the Income Tax Act, 1961: Statement I is correct because Section 80CCE imposes an overarching statutory ceiling of ₹1,50,000 on the combined deductions claimed under Sections 80C, 80CCC, and 80CCD(1). Statement II is correct because Section 80CCD(2) (employer's contribution to NPS up to 14% of salary for Central/State Government employees) is specifically excluded from the Section 80CCE cap and is allowable in addition to it. Statement III is correct because Section 80D permits up to ₹25,000 for non-senior citizen self/family and an additional deduction up to ₹50,000 for parents who are senior citizens (aged 60 years or above).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D (I, II और III) है। तीनों कथन आयकर अधिनियम के अनुसार पूर्णतः सत्य हैं: (I) धारा 80CCE के तहत धारा 80C, 80CCC और 80CCD(1) की संयुक्त कटौती की अधिकतम सीमा ₹1,50,000 है। (II) एनपीएस (NPS) में नियोक्ता का अंशदान (सरकारी कर्मचारियों के लिए वेतन का 14% तक) धारा 80CCD(2) के तहत धारा 80CCE की ₹1.5 लाख की सीमा के अतिरिक्त अनुमन्य है। (III) धारा 80D के तहत स्वयं व परिवार के स्वास्थ्य बीमा पर ₹25,000 तक तथा वरिष्ठ नागरिक माता-पिता के लिए अतिरिक्त ₹50,000 तक की कटौती प्राप्त होती है।

Section 80D allows ?25,000 for family health insurance and ?50,000 for senior citizen parents.

questions.question_english: Under Section 80EEA of the Income Tax Act, 1961, what is the maximum additional deduction allowed for interest paid on a loan taken for an affordable residential house property?
questions.explanation_english: Section 80EEA was introduced to incentivize affordable housing for first-time homebuyers. It allows an additional deduction of up to ₹1,50,000 per financial year for interest paid on housing loans sanctioned by a financial institution between 1st April 2019 and 31st March 2022. The stamp duty value of the residential property must not exceed ₹45 lakh, and the taxpayer must not own any other residential house on the date of sanction. This ₹1,50,000 deduction is over and above the ₹2,00,000 deduction available under Section 24(b) under the Old Tax Regime.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर D (₹1,50,000) है। किफायती आवास को बढ़ावा देने के लिए प्रथम बार घर खरीदने वालों हेतु आयकर अधिनियम में धारा 80EEA जोड़ी गई थी। इसके तहत ₹45 लाख तक के स्टाम्प ड्यूटी मूल्य वाले आवासीय मकान हेतु 1 अप्रैल 2019 से 31 मार्च 2022 के मध्य स्वीकृत गृह ऋण के ब्याज पर प्रतिवर्ष अधिकतम ₹1,50,000 तक की अतिरिक्त कटौती मिलती है। यह कटौती पुरानी व्यवस्था में धारा 24(b) के तहत मिलने वाली ₹2,00,000 की सामान्य कटौती के अतिरिक्त (Over and above) होती है।

key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) ₹1,50,000

questions.question_hindi:

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): If an employee opts for the New Tax Regime, they can still claim the deduction for interest on a home loan under Section 24(b) for a let-out (rented) property.
Reason (R): The restriction under Section 115BAC for Section 24(b) applies only to self-occupied properties.
In the context of the above statements, which of the following is correct?
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct, and Reason (R) is the accurate statutory explanation for Assertion (A). Under the New Tax Regime governed by Section 115BAC of the Income Tax Act, 1961, deductions for housing loan interest under Section 24(b) are expressly disallowed for 'self-occupied' house properties (where loss cannot be set off against salaries). However, for 'let-out' or rented properties, Section 24(b) interest deduction is fully allowable against the rental income to compute net income from house property. It is important to note that while interest is deductible against rent, any net loss under the head House Property cannot be set off against Salary income under Section 115BAC.

questions.explanation_english: Section 272B of the Income Tax Act, 1961 prescribes a specific monetary penalty of ₹10,000 for non-compliance with the provisions of Section 139A regarding Permanent Account Numbers. This penalty is attracted if a person fails to apply for a PAN when legally obligated, fails to quote their PAN in specified financial documents/transactions, or deliberately quotes a false PAN to evade tax deduction or reporting. The Assessing Officer can impose this ₹10,000 penalty for each such default after providing an opportunity of being heard.

questions.question_english: As an administrative head (DDO), what is the first step you should take upon discovering that TDS under Section 194C was inadvertently omitted from a past payment made to a contractual sanitation agency?
options_english: Wait until the next financial year and record the lapse as an audit objection in internal books
Deduct the omitted TDS amount from the agency's next pending bill and deposit it with interest under Section 201(1A)
Immediately blacklist the vendor agency and register a formal police complaint (FIR)
Reclassify the past bill as a non-contractual expenditure to conceal the deduction default
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 194C read with Section 200 and Section 201 of the Income Tax Act, 1961, the DDO is personal and statutory accountable for deducting TDS from contractual payments. If a DDO discovers that TDS was inadvertently omitted from a payment already disbursed to a contractor, the correct legal procedure is: (1) Immediately deduct the omitted tax amount from the contractor's next pending bill or recover it directly from the contractor; (2) Remit the deducted tax to the government treasury along with mandatory statutory interest under Section 201(1A) at 1% per month or part of a month from the date on which tax was deductible to the date of actual deduction; and (3) Update and file a correction statement in Form 26Q on TRACES.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर B है। आयकर अधिनियम की धारा 194C तथा धारा 201 के अंतर्गत, संविदात्मक भुगतानों पर टीडीएस कटौती की विधिक जिम्मेदारी DDO की होती है। यदि किसी संविदात्मक बिल पर भूलवश टीडीएस नहीं काटा गया, तो प्रशासनिक प्रमुख (DDO) का प्रथम वैधानिक दायित्व है कि वह एजेंसी के आगामी लंबित बिल से छूटी हुई टीडीएस राशि की कटौती करे तथा धारा 201(1A) के अनुसार कटौती की तिथि से वास्तविक कटौती की तिथि तक 1% प्रतिमाह की दर से लगने वाले वैधानिक ब्याज सहित इसे सरकारी कोष में जमा कराए, एवं फॉर्म 26Q में शुद्धि विवरणी (Correction Statement) दाखिल करे।

The DDO should immediately rectify the default by recovering the amount from subsequent contractual payments and depositing it with interest to avoid penal prosecution.

questions.question_english: What is meant by a "Nil TDS Return" in the context of statutory tax compliance by a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO)?
options_english: A return filed by an educational institution that does not possess a valid PAN or TAN
A return filed when an employee claims a complete refund of tax deducted during the year
A quarterly TDS statement filed by a deductor declaring zero tax deduction during the relevant quarter
A special tax return filed exclusively by non-profit educational or charitable organizations
questions.explanation_english: A "Nil TDS Return" refers to a quarterly tax statement submitted by a registered deductor (such as a school DDO having a TAN) indicating that no tax was deducted at source during that specific quarter. This situation typically arises when payments made to deductees or employees fall below statutory tax thresholds (e.g., employee salaries remaining within the basic exemption limit under Section 192, or vendor payments within the Section 194C threshold). While deductors can also file a 'Declaration for non-filing of TDS return' via TRACES if no taxable payments occurred, in statutory practice, submitting a quarterly statement declaring zero deduction confirms that the deductor was operational and had zero tax liability to remit for that quarter.
questions.explanation_hindi: "शून्य टीडीएस विवरणी" (Nil TDS Return) से तात्पर्य किसी पंजीकृत कटौतीकर्ता (जैसे टैन धारक विद्यालय का DDO) द्वारा दाखिल किए जाने वाले ऐसे त्रैमासिक विवरण से है, जिसमें यह प्रमाणित किया जाता है कि संबंधित तिमाही के दौरान स्रोत पर कोई कर कटौती (TDS) नहीं की गई है। ऐसी स्थिति सामान्यतः तब उत्पन्न होती है जब कर्मचारियों या संविदाकारों को किए गए भुगतान निर्धारित कर-योग्य सीमा से नीचे रहते हैं (जैसे धारा 192 के तहत कर्मचारियों का वेतन मूल छूट सीमा से कम होना या धारा 194C की सीमा के भीतर होना)। यद्यपि कटौतीकर्ता TRACES पर विवरणी दाखिल न करने का घोषणा-पत्र भी दे सकते हैं, किन्तु शून्य कटौती दर्शाने वाला यह विवरण यह पुष्ट करता है कि उक्त तिमाही के लिए कटौतीकर्ता की कोई टीडीएस देनदारी नहीं थी। अतः विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: With reference to statutory tax documents and their periodicity of filing or issuance in school administration, which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
options_english: Form 24Q – Quarterly statement of TDS on salaries
Form 26Q – Quarterly statement of TDS on payments other than salaries
Form 16 – Annual certificate of tax deducted at source from salary
Form 26AS – Monthly return filed by deductors
questions.explanation_english: Form 26AS is NOT a monthly return filed by deductors; rather, it is an annual consolidated tax credit statement generated dynamically by the Income Tax Department's TRACES portal against an individual's PAN. It reflects all TDS deducted, TCS collected, advance tax, self-assessment tax, and specified financial transactions across the entire financial year. In contrast, Form 24Q and Form 26Q are quarterly statements of TDS required to be filed by deductors (such as DDOs) under Section 200(3), and Form 16 is an annual tax deduction certificate issued to salaried employees under Section 203 by 15th June of the following financial year. Thus, pair D is incorrectly matched.
questions.explanation_hindi: फॉर्म 26AS कटौतीकर्ताओं (DDO) द्वारा मासिक रूप से दाखिल किया जाने वाला कोई रिटर्न नहीं है, बल्कि यह आयकर विभाग के TRACES पोर्टल द्वारा किसी व्यक्ति के पैन (PAN) पर गतिशील रूप से तैयार किया जाने वाला एक समेकित वार्षिक कर क्रेडिट विवरण (Annual Tax Statement) है। इसमें संबंधित वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान काटे गए टीडीएस (TDS), टीसीएस (TCS), अग्रिम कर एवं स्व-निर्धारण कर का पूरा ब्योरा स्वतः दर्ज होता रहता है। इसके विपरीत, फॉर्म 24Q (वेतन टीडीएस) एवं फॉर्म 26Q (गैर-वेतन टीडीएस) DDO द्वारा धारा 200(3) के तहत दाखिल की जाने वाली त्रैमासिक विवरणियां हैं, तथा फॉर्म 16 धारा 203 के तहत 15 जून तक जारी किया जाने वाला वार्षिक वेतन टीडीएस प्रमाण-पत्र है। अतः युग्म D गलत है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Form 26AS - Monthly

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Form 24Q and Form 26Q are filed quarterly by deductors to report salary and non-salary TDS respectively. Form 16 is issued annually as a salary tax certificate. Conversely, Form 26AS is an annual consolidated tax credit statement generated continuously by the tax system rather than being filed monthly by deductors.

questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं: एक को अभिकथन (A) और दूसरे को कारण (R) के रूप में लेबल किया गया है:
अभिकथन (A): यदि किसी कर्मचारी के फॉर्म 26AS में वेतन पर्ची (पे-स्लिप) के अनुसार वास्तव में काटे गए टीडीएस की तुलना में कम कर प्रदर्शित हो रहा है, तो कर्मचारी केवल वेतन पर्ची के आधार पर आयकर रिटर्न दाखिल करते समय पूरे कर क्रेडिट का सहजता से दावा कर सकता है।
कारण (R): फॉर्म 26AS नियोक्ता द्वारा दाखिल किए गए त्रैमासिक टीडीएस रिटर्न के आधार पर तैयार होता है; यदि नियोक्ता काटा गया कर जमा करने में चूक करता है या गलत पैन से रिटर्न दाखिल करता है, तो कर क्रेडिट फॉर्म 26AS में परिलक्षित नहीं होगा, जिससे स्वचालित बेमेल (mismatch) उत्पन्न होगा और सीपीसी (CPC) द्वारा मांग नोटिस जारी किया जाएगा।

questions.question_english:
Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R):
Assertion (A): An employee whose Form 26AS reflects less TDS than what was actually deducted as per their monthly salary pay slips can seamlessly claim the full tax credit while filing their Income Tax Return based solely on the pay slips.
Reason (R): Form 26AS is generated based on quarterly TDS returns filed by the employer; if the employer defaults in depositing the deducted tax or files the return with an incorrect PAN, the tax credit will not reflect in Form 26AS, resulting in an automated mismatch and demand notice from the CPC.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true. Under the automated e-filing and processing architecture of the Income Tax Department (CPC Bengaluru), tax credit claims in an Income Tax Return are strictly reconciled against the data pre-filled and validated in Form 26AS / Annual Information Statement (AIS). An employee cannot obtain tax credit merely on the strength of salary pay slips. If the employer or DDO fails to remit the tax into the government account or files Form 24Q with errors, the credit remains missing on TRACES, leading to an automated intimation/demand notice under Section 143(1). For the employee to obtain credit, the employer must rectify the discrepancy by filing a revised or correction TDS statement. Therefore, A is false and R is true.
questions.explanation_hindi: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु कारण (R) सही है। आयकर विभाग के सेंट्रलाइज्ड प्रोसेसिंग सेंटर (CPC) की स्वचालित प्रणाली में आयकर रिटर्न में किए गए कर क्रेडिट दावों का मिलान अनिवार्य रूप से फॉर्म 26AS / AIS में दर्ज आंकड़ों से किया जाता है। कर्मचारी केवल वेतन पर्ची के आधार पर कर क्रेडिट प्राप्त नहीं कर सकता। यदि नियोक्ता या DDO कर जमा करने में विफल रहता है अथवा फॉर्म 24Q में गलत पैन दर्ज करता है, तो वह क्रेडिट TRACES पोर्टल पर प्रदर्शित नहीं होगा। ऐसी स्थिति में रिटर्न दाखिल करने पर धारा 143(1) के तहत क्रेडिट बेमेल (mismatch) का नोटिस और कर मांग जारी हो जाएगी। क्रेडिट प्राप्त करने के लिए नियोक्ता को संशोधित टीडीएस रिटर्न (correction statement) दाखिल करना अनिवार्य होता है। अतः A गलत है और R सही है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) A is false but R is true

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: If Form 26AS reflects less TDS than shown on salary pay slips due to employer default or non- filing, the employee cannot claim tax credit based solely on pay slips. Tax credits are processed strictly based on Form 26AS entries, resulting in potential demand notices until the employer files corrected returns.

questions.question_english: In a situation where the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) has deducted TDS from an employee's salary but fails to deposit it into the Central Government account, what statutory protection is available to the employee under the Income Tax Act, 1961?
options_english: The employee is legally required to pay the tax amount once again directly to the Income Tax Department
Section 205 legally bars the income tax authorities from demanding payment of tax directly from the employee where tax has already been deducted
The employee receives total statutory immunity from filing income tax returns for the subsequent five financial years
The employee's Permanent Account Number (PAN) is placed under suspension until the defaulting DDO remits the tax
questions.explanation_english: Section 205 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 provides express statutory protection to taxpayers from whom tax has already been withheld at source. It states that where tax is deductible at source, the assessee (employee) shall not be called upon to pay the tax himself to the extent to which tax has actually been deducted from that income. The CBDT, through Office Memorandums and instructions (e.g., Instruction No. 275/29/2014-IT(B)), as well as several landmark High Court judgments, has reiterated that the tax recovery proceedings for deducted but unremitted TDS can only be instituted against the defaulting deductor/employer as an 'assessee-in-default' under Section 201, and cannot be recovered from the employee whose tax was deducted at source.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 205 करदाता (कर्मचारी) को स्पष्ट सांविधिक संरक्षण प्रदान करती है। धारा 205 के अनुसार, जहां किसी आय से स्रोत पर कर की कटौती कर ली गई है, उस सीमा तक संबंधित करदाता से दोबारा कर भुगतान की मांग नहीं की जा सकती। सीबीडीटी (CBDT) के निर्देशों (जैसे अनुदेश सं. 275/29/2014-IT(B)) और विभिन्न उच्च न्यायालयों के न्यायिक निर्णयों में यह स्पष्ट किया गया है कि यदि नियोक्ता/DDO ने वेतन से कर काट लिया है और उसे सरकारी खजाने में जमा नहीं किया है, तो आयकर विभाग कर्मचारी से उस कर की वसूली नहीं कर सकता। विभाग धारा 201 के अंतर्गत दोषी कटौतीकर्ता (DDO) को ही 'डिफ़ॉल्ट में निर्धारिती' मानते हुए ब्याज और जुर्माने सहित वसूली की कार्यवाही करने के लिए बाध्य है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Section 205 bars tax demands from employees for tax already deducted.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: for tax already deducted. Section 205 of the Income Tax Act provides legal protection to taxpayers from whom tax has already been deducted at source. Where tax has been actually deducted by an employer or deductor, tax authorities are legally barred from demanding payment of that tax directly from the employee or deductee.

questions.question_english: Which statutory financial register/record is primarily maintained by the Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) in a school to track the month-wise deduction of income tax from employees and its remittance to the PAO or Treasury?
options_english: Service Book and Personal Records Register
TDS Register (Tax Deduction at Source Register)
Contingent Register
Stock and Asset Register
questions.explanation_english: The TDS Register is the essential statutory financial register maintained by every Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO). It systematically records employee-wise and month-wise details of gross salary, permissible deductions under Chapter VI-A, net taxable salary, amount of income tax (TDS) deducted, challan/book transfer transfer numbers, BSR code, and the date of remittance to the Treasury or Pay and Accounts Office (PAO). This register provides the primary audit trail required for monthly reconciliation, quarterly Form 24Q e-TDS filing, and the annual generation of Form 16 certificates.
questions.explanation_hindi: टीडीएस रजिस्टर (TDS Register) प्रत्येक आहरण एवं संवितरण अधिकारी (DDO) द्वारा संधारित किया जाने वाला एक अनिवार्य सांविधिक वित्तीय अभिलेख है। इसमें प्रत्येक कर्मचारी का नाम, पैन, माहवार सकल वेतन, अध्याय VI-A के तहत अनुमन्य कटौतियां, शुद्ध कर-योग्य वेतन, काटी गई टीडीएस राशि, चालान/बुक ट्रांसफर संदर्भ संख्या, बीएसआर कोड तथा राजकोष अथवा वेतन एवं लेखा कार्यालय (PAO) में प्रेषण की तिथि का संपूर्ण विवरण दर्ज किया जाता है। यह रजिस्टर मासिक मिलान, त्रैमासिक फॉर्म 24Q विवरणी दाखिल करने तथा कर्मचारियों को वार्षिक फॉर्म 16 प्रमाण-पत्र जारी करने के लिए प्राथमिक आधार प्रदान करता है। अतः विकल्प B सही उत्तर है।

questions.question_english: Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, 1961 (Payments to Contractors), the threshold limit for deducting TDS for a single contract is ₹30,000. What is the aggregate monetary limit for payments credited or paid to a single contractor during a financial year beyond which TDS deduction becomes mandatory?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, 1961, any specified person (including a school DDO/principal) responsible for paying any sum to a resident contractor for carrying out any work (including transport, maintenance, catering, housekeeping, security, etc.) must deduct tax at source. The statutory thresholds are dual: (1) TDS is attracted if a single sum credited or paid exceeds ₹30,000; OR (2) where the aggregate of sums credited or paid to that contractor during the financial year exceeds ₹1,00,000 (even if each individual payment was less than ₹30,000). Once the aggregate crosses ₹1,00,000, TDS is applicable on the entire cumulative amount at 1% for individual/HUF contractors and 2% for corporate/firm contractors.
questions.explanation_hindi: आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 194C के अंतर्गत, किसी निवासी ठेकेदार/संविदाकार (जैसे विद्यालय में रखरखाव, परिवहन, कैटरिंग, सुरक्षा आदि कार्य करने वाले) को भुगतान करते समय DDO को टीडीएस काटना होता है। इसके लिए दोहरी सीमा निर्धारित है: (1) यदि किसी एकल संविदा या बिल के भुगतान की राशि ₹30,000 से अधिक हो; अथवा (2) यदि वित्तीय वर्ष के दौरान उस एकल संविदाकार को किए गए या देय कुल भुगतानों की संचयी राशि ₹1,00,000 से अधिक हो जाती है (भले ही प्रत्येक व्यक्तिगत बिल ₹30,000 से कम का क्यों न रहा हो)। ₹1,00,000 की कुल सीमा पार होते ही पूरी संचयी राशि पर टीडीएस (व्यक्ति/HUF के लिए 1% तथा कंपनी/फर्म के लिए 2%) काटना अनिवार्य हो जाता है। अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प C (₹1,00,000) है।
questions.topic: Income Tax and GST Basics for School Administration
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) ₹1,00,000

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under Section 194C of the Income Tax Act, tax deduction at source is triggered if an individual contract payment exceeds thirty thousand rupees. Additionally, if the aggregate total of payments made or credited to a single contractor during a financial year exceeds one lakh rupees, TDS mandatory deduction rules apply.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding statutory declarations in Form 15G and Form 15H:
I. Form 15G is submitted by an individual (below 60 years of age) or HUF for non-deduction of TDS, provided their estimated total income is below the maximum taxable limit.
II. Form 15H is a declaration available exclusively to resident senior citizens (aged 60 years or above).
III. Salaried school teachers can submit Form 15G or Form 15H to the DDO to completely stop TDS deduction on their salary income.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I and II only
II and III only
I and III only
I, II, and III
questions.explanation_english: Statements I and II are correct, while Statement III is incorrect. Under Section 197A of the Income Tax Act, 1961, Form 15G (for individuals below 60 years and HUFs) and Form 15H (for resident senior citizens aged 60 and above) are statutory self-declaration forms for non-deduction of TDS on specified non-salary payments (such as interest on fixed deposits under Section 194A, dividends under Section 194, premature EPF withdrawals under Section 192A, etc.) when the individual's estimated total income does not exceed the basic exemption limit. Crucially, Form 15G and Form 15H CANNOT be submitted to an employer/DDO to stop or prevent TDS deduction on salary under Section 192. Lower or nil deduction on salary income can only be authorized by the Assessing Officer issuing a certificate under Section 197.
questions.explanation_hindi: कथन I और II सही हैं, जबकि कथन III गलत है। आयकर अधिनियम, 1961 की धारा 197A के अंतर्गत, फॉर्म 15G (60 वर्ष से कम आयु के व्यक्तियों और HUF के लिए) तथा फॉर्म 15H (60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए) स्व-घोषणा पत्र हैं, जिनका उपयोग गैर-वेतन भुगतानों (जैसे बैंक सावधि जमा पर ब्याज - धारा 194A, लाभांश - धारा 194 आदि) पर टीडीएस न काटने के लिए किया जाता है, बशर्ते व्यक्ति की कुल आय कर-मुक्त सीमा के भीतर हो। वेतन आय पर धारा 192 के तहत होने वाली टीडीएस कटौती को रोकने के लिए फॉर्म 15G या फॉर्म 15H प्रस्तुत नहीं किया जा सकता। वेतन पर कम या शून्य कटौती के लिए कर्मचारी को धारा 197 के अंतर्गत संबंधित आयकर निर्धारण अधिकारी से सांविधिक प्रमाण-पत्र प्राप्त करना होता है। अतः केवल कथन I और II सही हैं।

Assertion (A): While computing monthly TDS on salary under Section 192, a Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) cannot grant deductions for donations made by an employee under Section 80G, except for donations made to specified government funds (such as the PM National Relief Fund, CM's Relief Fund, etc.).

Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A

A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) correctly explains Assertion (A). Under the statutory circulars issued annually by the CBDT governing the deduction of income tax at source from salaries under Section 192, employers/DDOs are explicitly barred from allowing deductions under Section 80G for donations made by employees to private charitable institutions, trusts, or funds. The DDO is only permitted to consider donations made to specific designated funds such as the Prime Minister's National Relief Fund, National Defence Fund, Chief Minister's Relief Fund, etc., where the donation is often routed through payroll or substantiated by official receipts. For general charitable donations, the employee must report the deduction independently in their annual Income Tax Return (ITR), where the deduction is validated against the electronic Form 10BE issued by the registered charitable trust.

questions.question_english: Which section of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017 outlines the scope of "Supply", which constitutes the taxable event triggering GST liability?
options_english: Section 9
Section 16
Section 7
Section 22
questions.explanation_english: Section 7 of the Central Goods and Services Tax (CGST) Act, 2017 defines the scope of "Supply", which is the foundational taxable event under the GST framework. It encompasses all forms of supply of goods or services or both, such as sale, transfer, barter, exchange, licence, rental, lease, or disposal made or agreed to be made for a consideration by a person in the course or furtherance of business. In comparison, Section 9 deals with the Levy and Collection of CGST, Section 16 governs eligibility and conditions for taking Input Tax Credit (ITC), and Section 22 specifies persons liable for mandatory GST registration.
questions.explanation_hindi: केंद्रीय माल और सेवा कर (CGST) अधिनियम, 2017 की धारा 7 "आपूर्ति" (Supply) के दायरे को परिभाषित करती है, जो वस्तु एवं सेवा कर व्यवस्था के तहत कर अधिरोपित करने वाली मूलभूत कर-योग्य घटना है। इसके अंतर्गत व्यापार के अनुक्रम अथवा संवर्धन में किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा प्रतिफल (consideration) के बदले की गई वस्तुओं या सेवाओं की आपूर्ति के सभी रूप शामिल हैं, जैसे बिक्री, अंतरण (ट्रांसफर), वस्तु-विनिमय (बार्टर), विनिमय, लाइसेंस, किराया, पट्टा या निस्तारण। इसके विपरीत, धारा 9 जीएसटी के प्रभार एवं संग्रहण से, धारा 16 इनपुट टैक्स क्रेडिट (ITC) की शर्तों से, तथा धारा 22 अनिवार्य पंजीकरण के लिए उत्तरदायी व्यक्तियों से संबंधित है। अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प C (धारा 7) है।

questions.question_english: If a school receives an application under the Right to Information (RTI) Act, 2005 seeking specific personal details regarding the exact amount of income tax (TDS) deducted and deposited for an individual teacher, how should the Principal (functioning as the Public Information Officer - PIO) legally respond?
options_english: Provide the detailed tax information immediately because the deduction involves public treasury remittances
Deny the request under Section 8(1)(j) of the RTI Act as it constitutes personal information having no relationship to any public activity or interest
Deny the information under Section 8(1)(a) of the RTI Act stating that tax matters impact the economic sovereignty of the nation
Direct the applicant to personally contact the concerned teacher to inspect their private income tax records
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 8(1)(j) of the Right to Information Act, 2005, personal information the disclosure of which has no relationship to any public activity or interest, or which would cause unwarranted invasion of the privacy of an individual, is exempt from disclosure unless the PIO or appellate authority is satisfied that the larger public interest justifies it. The Supreme Court of India in the landmark ruling of Girish Ramchandra Deshpande v. Central Information Commissioner (2012) categorically held that details of an employee's salary deductions, income tax returns, TDS statements, and personal assets qualify as personal information protected under Section 8(1)(j). Therefore, the Principal/PIO must deny disclosure unless a substantiated larger public interest is established by the applicant.
questions.explanation_hindi: सूचना का अधिकार (RTI) अधिनियम, 2005 की धारा 8(1)(j) के अनुसार, ऐसी व्यक्तिगत सूचना जिसके प्रकटीकरण का किसी लोक क्रियाकलाप या लोक हित से कोई संबंध नहीं है, अथवा जिससे व्यक्ति की निजता पर अकारण अतिक्रमण होता हो, प्रकट किए जाने से मुक्त है; जब तक कि लोक सूचना अधिकारी का यह समाधान न हो जाए कि व्यापक लोक हित ऐसे प्रकटीकरण का औचित्य सिद्ध करता है। भारत के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने 'गिरीश रामचंद्र देशपांडे बनाम केंद्रीय सूचना आयुक्त (2012)' के ऐतिहासिक निर्णय में यह स्पष्ट रूप से निर्धारित किया कि किसी कर्मचारी के वेतन से कटौतियों, आयकर रिटर्न, टीडीएस विवरण तथा व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय आंकड़े धारा 8(1)(j) के तहत संरक्षित व्यक्तिगत सूचना हैं। अतः किसी स्पष्ट जनहित के अभाव में प्राचार्य (PIO) को धारा 8(1)(j) के अंतर्गत यह जानकारी देने से मना करना चाहिए।

questions.question_hindi: केंद्रीय माल और सेवा कर (CGST) अधिनियम, 2017 की धारा 2(30) के अंतर्गत "संयुक्त आपूर्ति" (Composite Supply) को निम्नलिखित में से किस रूप में सही परिभाषित किया गया है, जो विशेष रूप से तब प्रासंगिक होती है जब विद्यालय शैक्षणिक और सहायक सेवाओं को बंडल करते हैं?

खुले बाजार में एक ही समग्र मूल्य पर एक साथ बेची जाने वाली असंबंधित वस्तुओं का पैकेज
विशेष रूप से गैर-करयोग्य निर्यात वस्तुओं और अपतटीय डिजिटल शैक्षणिक सामग्री से युक्त आपूर्ति
